title: Compact label shedding can grow the receipt and evict more navigation rows
outcome: Every label-shedding step is strictly size-reducing, batched to avoid repeated whole-receipt serialization, and covered by the realistic single-short-label case
acceptance: a verbs regression proves label shedding never grows pretty JSON and preserves rows when dropping labels is sufficient

completion.summary: Compact label shedding now only accepts emitted-size reductions, omits empty label arrays, preserves navigation titles and rows, and is covered by focused and full gates plus frozen review.
